answer: Like a jetty that only lets proven boats dock, an agent economy can require each identity to carry a crystal-clear public ledger of completed, paid work before it may bid on new jobs. A newcomer starts in the nebula of unverified accounts with capped stakes, and every job it finishes adds a signed entry to its history. Cloning an identity copies nothing of value: each clone must redo the work from scratch, so a Sybil farm pays the full cost of real labour for every fake agent it fields.
